opennyai_summary.decision:
(Exemption) in BAIL APPLN. 951/2023 Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
BAIL APPLN. 950/2023 & BAIL APPLN. 951/2023 These are petitions filed by the petitioner under Section 438 Cr.P.C. seeking anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 113/2023 under Sections 406/420/34 IPC registered at Police Station Vikaspuri.
The main dispute appears to be with regard to the receipt dated 30.1.2022 wherein according to the counsel for the petitioner, false entries of Rs.80,00,000/- approximately have been made by the complainant.
Let the original receipt be produced by the complainant.
Till then, no coercive action be taken against the petitioners.
